subject: planner: Make explain code call non-recursive functions to build plans instead of planner.Optimize. (#62798)
summary: Diff touches only `pkg/planner/core/planbuilder.go` and `pkg/planner/optimize.go`. Main change: `PlanBuilder.buildExplain` now builds the target plan via `OptimizeAstNodeNoCache` for normal EXPLAIN formats and uses `OptimizeAstNode` (now wired to `optimizeCache`) only for `EXPLAIN FORMAT='plan_cache'`. `Optimize` is refactored to delegate cache handling to a new `optimizeCache` helper; non-prepared plan-cache lookup now takes `*resolve.NodeW`. Reviewed call paths for EXPLAIN/EXPLAIN ANALYZE, privilege checks, plan-cache gating, session/StmtCtx side-effects, and recursion risk; no remaining Blocker/High correctness/semantics issues found in this commit.
